# Documentation API

3 endpoints. Request and response schemas are described on the [schemas page](schemas.md); the other tags are listed in the [API index](README.md).

## Endpoints

### `GET /api/v1/openapi.json`

OpenAPI specification

Returns the OpenAPI 3.0 specification in JSON format

**Authentication:** none (public endpoint).

**Responses**

| Status | Description | Body |
|---|---|---|
| `200` | OpenAPI specification | `application/json`: object |

### `GET /api/v1/openapi.yaml`

OpenAPI specification (YAML)

Returns the OpenAPI 3.0 specification in YAML format

**Authentication:** none (public endpoint).

**Responses**

| Status | Description | Body |
|---|---|---|
| `200` | OpenAPI specification | `application/yaml`: object |

### `GET /swagger/`

Swagger UI

| Status | Description | Body |
